# Yasemin Kahve

> Turkish-origin specialty green coffee importer, producer, and wholesale supplier — born in Guatemala, perfected in Turkey since 1921. Serves distributors, coffee shops, and restaurants worldwide, and runs a coffee academy.

## Summary
Yasemin Kahve is a Turkish coffee exporter and premium green (unroasted) coffee bean supplier. Beans are sourced from the company's family-owned farms in Guatemala plus origins worldwide, and supplied to distributors and coffee shops globally. The company also offers high-quality cardamom, Eversys coffee machines, and professional coffee education through Yasemin Kahve Academy.

## Products
- Wholesale green coffee — premium unroasted beans for roasters and distributors
- Retail green coffee — smaller-quantity green beans
- Coffee machines — Eversys
- Cardamom — premium spice

Selected origins & varieties:
- Mogiana Linda Brazil Fine Cup 17–18 (Brazil)
- Tucano Rio Minas 17–18 (Brazil)
- Indian Arabica Plantation AA (India)
- Uganda Robusta 18 (Uganda)
- Ethiopia Lekempti GR4 (Ethiopia)
- Colombia Supremo 17–18 (Colombia)

## Academy
Yasemin Kahve Academy offers professional coffee education. (Course details are published in the members' area — sign-in required.)

## Key facts
- Founded: 1921
- Head office: Başakşehir, İstanbul, Türkiye
- Sourcing: family-owned green coffee farms in Guatemala + worldwide origins
